adminGeneric._comment: Admin App Generic/shell batch on thor (modules ASHL, FOOT, MYPR, SADB, SRQS, SKEY, INVI). Every value below was verified live on 2026-09-14 — admin-shared.md §A12. NO ABSOLUTE COUNT of shared data appears anywhere: the unread-notification total is live (92 -> 93 in two weeks), so notification cases compare counts within one run (ADR-021 rule 1). Account-specific values (names, pre-filled location) are READ at run time, never stored here.

foot._comment: TST_FOOT_TC_10/11. Seven links — our register's count was right; the other team's five-link list is incomplete. FAQs and Help both lead to the same external help centre (an environment-specific *helptest* host on thor) and are not navigated. 'Our approach' has rel="nopener" — misspelt, a minor security-hygiene defect recorded in §A12, not asserted as correct.

mypr._comment: TST_MYPR_TC_1..4 on testt1 — the login for every admin suite. unsavedFirstName is an unmistakable marker typed but NEVER saved; if a run ever finds it saved, the test's safety net restores the original name (read at run time) and fails loudly [user decision, 2026-09-14].

sadb._comment: TST_SADB_TC_3/5. Schools are addressed by KEY — two schools share the name '3 July Test School 1'. Org slugs are captured values, never constructed (§A10). uniqueClassName is our permanent fixture class on FCN-CHZ-PDA (never-delete list, §A7), used as a falsifiable no-carry-over check. The document title is not stored — it varies with the load path.

srqs._comment: TST_SRQS_TC_3. NOTHING HERE IS EVER SUBMITTED — the case stops on the summary. Location and telephone code arrive pre-filled from the account and are read at run time, not stored. partialLocation, nonNumericTelephone and malformedUrl are the blocked-state inputs verified live on 2026-09-14.

skey._comment: TST_SKEY_TC_1/2/4. 🚨 schoolKey is KNF-XRD-QVE and MUST NEVER be FCN-CHZ-PDA [user decision, 2026-09-14] — FCN-CHZ-PDA's key is hardcoded across every admin suite. forbiddenSchoolKey is checked by TST_SKEY_TC_100 as a safety interlock, so an accidental edit of schoolKey cannot silently aim the suite at the primary school.
